text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian suffers defeat at the Arima 
Kinen. Hishi Amazon can hardly believe it, 
having chased after her all this time as 
the ultimate wall to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian rebuked them, telling them to 
"accept the results." She also declared 
that she was "not the kind of Umamusume 
who would be finished just from being 
broken once..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class begins next year. Narita 
Brian sets her sights on the Hanshin 
Daishoten.
